sig: [[["A", "Good morning, it's seven fifteen, and here's your traffic and weather update on City Radio."], ["A", "If you're heading into the city on the Northern Highway, expect delays of around twenty-five minutes."], ["A", "A truck has broken down near Exit 12, and two of the three southbound lanes are closed."], ["A", "Crews are on the scene, but they don't expect to clear it before eight thirty."], ["A", "So if you can, take Riverside Drive instead; it's moving freely at the moment."], ["A", "Commuters on the Bay Line trains, good news: services are back to normal after yesterday's signal fault."], ["A", "Now, the weather. It's a cool fourteen degrees right now, climbing to around twenty-two by the afternoon."], ["A", "But don't let the sunshine fool you."], ["A", "A band of heavy rain is moving in from the west and should hit the city around five o'clock, just in time for the evening rush."], ["A", "The weather bureau has also issued a wind warning for coastal areas from six tonight."], ["A", "We'll have another update at seven forty-five, right after the news."]], {"A": "F-AU"}]
